in_hebrew.name: Levin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Levin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'leon', meaning 'lion' or 'mountain'. This name carries a strong, powerful, and courageous meaning, evoking the image of a mighty lion or mountain. In Christian tradition, Levin is also associated with the Levites, a priestly tribe in ancient Israel.
